Failure at lambda=0 indicates KDE residual bias and kNN threshold instability; this alone blocks SURVIVES and prevents FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING which requires null pass for both at 1000.

Recompute CV on frozen measurand (BC with N=200 permutation subtraction) and report per-replication values: current CV computed on raw kde_kl/knn_mi without BC subtraction (run_execute_v3.py:135-152 std/mean of raw) inflates/deflates variance relative to parent BC (parent result.json:metrics.kde_per_type.lambda1_cv_per_type). validity_findings.finding: DGP produces divergence magnitudes qualitatively different from parent: parent KDE BC at lambda1 per-type mean 0.182 vs pooled 0.064; current KDE pooled raw at lambda1 ~0.036-0.055 (lower), observed_raw per-type at lambda0 0.08-0.21 similar to parent 0.099-0.151 but CV 0.35 vs 0.57 indicates shifted variance. Provider provenance notes 'DGP action_offset scaled by lambda (parent DGP not fully recoverable)' and 'heteroscedastic Gaussian lambda-scaled action effects'. Per-type KDE values at lambda1 ~0.13-0.15 mean vs parent 0.18 mean, but CV denominators smaller due to lower absolute signal. This confirms DGP/estimator mismatch, not sample-size effect.

kNN MI estimator returns near-constant 1.26-1.44 bits regardless of lambda, type, or n. Raw per_type knn_lambda1_values in raw_evidence cluster around 1.30 with std ~0.06 (CV 0.058), while parent per_type raw at lambda0 is 0.001-0.02 and BC at lambda1 0.138. Current null observed values 1.31-1.44 vs parent 0.007-0.020 prove estimator substitution: run_execute_v3.py uses joint [S, one_hot(A)] + eps = kth joint distance + count of S within eps with same A (digamma(k)-digamma(nc+1)+digamma(n)-E[digamma(count_A)]). Parent uses Kraskov kNN with correctly calibrated thresholds 0.046-0.053. Current thresholds 1.41-1.45 match action entropy, not conditional MI. CV artificially low because numerator and denominator both ~1.3 constant.

CV computed on raw kde_kl/knn_mi (run_execute_v3.py:145-152 std/mean of raw across 5 reps) not on BC divergence max(0, observed - perm_mean) required by spec measurement_validity. Parent CV is on BC divergence with N=200 permutation subtraction; current ignores null subtraction, inflating comparability error. Seed formula cell_seed = BASE_SEED*100000 + lambda_idx*1000 + rep_idx*10 + 999 correctly used per replication, but per-type N per replication generated via cs+ti*7 offset extends beyond parent validation and lambda scaling inside DGP (S_det %1.0, noise scaling 0.5+norm(S_cur-offset)) differs from parent block-cycling description. No unseeded np.random calls remain (unlike predecessor's np.random.normal bug), but calibration remains unvalidated.

All evidence remains synthetic 2D [0,1]^2, 8 heterogeneous affine types (rotation/scaling/translation x low/high noise x centered/shifted) with heteroscedastic Gaussian noise. No inference to real Web DOM transitions warranted (per prereg 9.1, spec baselines). Leakage not applicable (per-type data isolated, permutation shuffles action within type), sampling integrity valid for spec (N=200 perms, 8 lambdas, 5 reps, totals 80k/160k/320k transitions), but environment cannot express tested Web-dynamical effect beyond synthetic proxy.

baseline_findings.finding: Parent KDE baseline at 250/type: null 8/8 pass, CV max 0.5745 type4 marginal fail (7/8 pass, 14.9% over), positive t=7.81 p=0.0007. Current KDE at 250: null 6/8 fail (types0,5 > threshold), CV max 0.3496 8/8 pass (39% below), positive t=1.79 p=0.074 fail. Baseline not replicated in direction or significance; CV pass is artifact of low-variance raw estimator on mismatched DGP, not improvement. Parent marginal failure cannot be used to predict sample-size scaling from this packet.

Parent kNN baseline at 250/type: null 8/8 pass (max raw 0.02 <= thr 0.046-0.053), CV max 0.7550 type0 substantial fail (51% over), positive t=6.82 p=0.0012. Current kNN at 250: null 7/8 fail (type2 1.408 >1.392), CV max 0.0578 8/8 pass (13x smaller), positive t=0.07 p=0.475 fail. Absolute MI scale 65x larger (1.32 vs 0.0017 at lambda0) proves estimator substitution, not improved stability. Exploratory kNN k=10 CV 0.470 baseline (spec baselines[2]) not recomputed; cannot assess sensitivity.

Spec baselines include binned TV at 250/type per-type null 4/8 fail CV max 1.59 (from EXP-FRONTIER-34881708619) and frequency baseline marginal TV 0.335 as reference comparators for estimator-specific false-positive and absolute signal strength. Neither was recomputed at 250/500/1000 in this packet (report validity_notes acknowledges synthetic-only scope). Ordering comparison (KDE/kNN per-type>pooled vs binned pooled>per-type) untested; absolute BC magnitudes at larger n (KDE pooled ~0.024-0.055, kNN pooled ~1.32) incomparable to frequency baseline due to different units. No strong baseline exceeds measurement invalid threshold.

Controls are strong and correctly gating: pipeline validation (5% tolerance) and per-measure positive/null controls per spec are not weak nulls. Parent demonstrated they discriminate between estimator artifacts (binned TV fail vs KDE/kNN pass) and sensitivity (positive pass vs CV fail). Current run shows controls correctly reject invalid measurement despite apparent CV pass (all CV <=0.5). This confirms control suite's discriminating power and validates audit's MEASUREMENT_INVALID verdict.

claim_ceiling: MEASUREMENT_INVALID — No justified claim about per-type CV stability (<=0.5 at lambda=1) at 500 or 1000/type for KDE Scott or kNN k=5. Producer correctly declares MEASUREMENT_INVALID, INCONCLUSIVE; audit confirms. Apparent CV passes (all max 0.27-0.35 for KDE, 0.056-0.062 for kNN, 8/8 pass at all n) are invalid: they are computed on a different measurand (raw KL/MI without BC permutation subtraction, broken kNN returning action entropy ~1.3 bits) and under DGP that fails pipeline validation (>5% off parent), positive control (kNN fails at all n, KDE fails at 250/500), and null control (KDE never 8/8). Maximum justified descriptive ceiling is narrow: on this synthetic 2D [0,1]^2 heterogeneous affine DGP (3 families rotation/scaling/translation x low/high noise x centered/shifted, heteroscedastic Gaussian, lambda-scaled affine, seed formula cs+ti*7, Scott KDE, run_execute_v3 kNN), pooled detection is weak/absent except KDE at 1000, null false-positive rate ~12-25%, and kNN MI is insensitive (constant 1.3 bits). No inference to parent sample-size hypothesis (KDE marginal 0.5745 may be sample-size-limited vs kNN 0.755 fundamental) and no inference to real Web DOM dynamics. Parent ceilings unchanged: KDE and kNN achieve per-type null 8/8 where binned TV fails 4/8 at 250/type, but per-type CV fails for both at 250/type (KDE max 0.5745, kNN max 0.7550) per EXP-FRONTIER-34913743596 audit PASS. Next experiment must recover parent DGP/estimator calibration at 250/type within 5% before testing larger n or kNN k=10 confirmatory.
